verdicts.question: granted action
verdicts.ours: burnByRef: the burn referendum is a card-less political candidate, +1 stealth as the total, owner burns it on a pass; no stealth key of the card's own
verdicts.theirs: Any vampire may declare a political action with +1 stealth calling a referendum to burn the card
verdicts.why: The granted action is any vampire's +1 stealth political action calling a referendum (no card vote) that burns Anarch Revolt on a pass; our burnByRef carries exactly that and deliberately no card stealth.

verdicts.question: other clauses
verdicts.ours: master, persistent, noAnarchTax (bot bills itself 1 pool per copy at end of unlock phase; human reminded), burnByRef
verdicts.theirs: Rider at unlock phase end, every copy, burn 1 pool unless a ready Anarch; same burn referendum
verdicts.why: Put-in-play, no cost or requirement, the end-of-unlock timing and the per-copy cumulation are all carried; only the bot's own bill is modelled, opponents' being table-handled.

verdicts.question: granted action (referendum)
verdicts.ours: mode at null, dir:true, fx poolGain 2 (auto read, as if the card's own directed action giving 2 pool)
verdicts.theirs: Ability: any Methuselah's Sabbat vampire, once each turn (per player turn), political action, +1 stealth, referendum, controller gains 2 pool
verdicts.fix: Not a card play and not directed: a granted political action by a ready Sabbat vampire (the caller's controller gains 2 pool if the referendum passes), +1 stealth (granted, not the card's number), limited to once each turn and counted as attempted even if blocked. Drop dir and the immediate poolGain 2 as a card-own effect; register the granted referendum.
verdicts.why: Our dir:true poolGain:2 reads the granted political referendum as a directed action of the card itself; the text gives pool only to the calling vampire's controller on a passed referendum, once each turn, by a Sabbat vampire.

verdicts.question: granted action (changeling burn)
verdicts.ours: nothing (no mode for it; the dir:true mode is the only action)
verdicts.theirs: Ability: a changeling ally (any Methuselah's) burns the card as a +1 stealth Ⓓ action directed at the controller
verdicts.why: Granted action, deliberately not modelled: any changeling ally (not only ours) may burn this location as a +1 stealth directed action, which also counts as an action requiring Sabbat per the ruling; our entry carries no stealth for it on purpose.

verdicts.question: other clauses
verdicts.ours: t master, unique, persistent, one mode dir:true poolGain 2, no req
verdicts.theirs: Play requires ready Sabbat (control); referendum limited PerTurn; burn by changeling
verdicts.fix: Add the play requirement: the controller must control a ready Sabbat vampire to put it in play (req sect Sabbat as a controller condition, not the acting minion). Remove the dir:true poolGain 2 mode (see the referendum line).
verdicts.why: The 'Requires a ready Sabbat vampire' clause is missing from our req (it would let a bot play it without a Sabbat vampire), and the only mode misreads the granted referendum as the card's own directed action.

verdicts.question: obf level with no mode
verdicts.ours: no mode at obf (modes: null bleedAct, ani bleed 1, pre bloodAdd 1 to uncontrolled)
verdicts.theirs: Mode with IfBleedSuccessful lock a minion of the target, minion chosen at resolution, prey needs none
verdicts.fix: Add an obf mode: on a successful bleed the acting vampire's controller may lock one minion controlled by the target Methuselah (chosen on resolution; no minion needed to play it). The key for a conditional lock of a target's minion on bleed success does not exist.
verdicts.why: The obf line prints a distinct success rider (lock a minion of the bled Methuselah) that no mode of ours carries; the bot would play the card with obf as plain bleed 1.

verdicts.question: other clauses
verdicts.ours: action, req disc ani/obf/pre, anarchReq, null bleedAct dir, ani bleed 1, pre bloodAdd 1 bloodAddTo unc
verdicts.theirs: 7 modes: each single discipline and each combination (ani+obf, ani+pre, obf+pre, all) with the effects stacked
verdicts.fix: Combinations: the effects of two or three used disciplines stack (e.g. ani+pre is bleed 2 plus the blood on success); say that explicitly or confirm the engine adds the modes of each discipline the vampire has. The pre blood is only on a successful bleed and the uncontrolled vampire is chosen on declaration (bloodAdd carries the target but check it is conditional on success).
verdicts.why: Base bleed, Anarch requirement, ani +1 and pre blood are carried; the multi-discipline stacking and the success condition of the pre rider are not stated in our entry, so only the obf gap is certain; unsure until the engine's handling of combined disciplines is checked.

verdicts.question: pot|pre level with no mode
verdicts.ours: no mode at pot or pre (only POT and PRE blockBar chosen); exactness record: intercept open 10.20
verdicts.theirs: Mode on block attempt: AttemptingIntercept -1
verdicts.fix: Add inferior (pot, pre) modes: playable only when a minion attempts to block; the attempting blocker gets -1 intercept (a penalty to the blocker's intercept applied to the block attempt, not to our own intercept). The key for a negative intercept on the opposing blocker does not exist.
verdicts.why: The inferior line is a separate effect (-1 intercept to the blocking minion when it attempts to block) with its own timing, and our entry has nothing at that level.

verdicts.question: other clauses
verdicts.ours: POT and PRE modes fx blockBar 'chosen'; req disc pot/pre
verdicts.theirs: Window action-as-announced, target a vampire, target cannot block
verdicts.why: The superior clause (as-announced, a chosen vampire cannot block) is carried by blockBar chosen at both POT and PRE; ordering rulings are engine-side.

verdicts.question: ani level with no mode
verdicts.ours: no mode at ani (only ANI press:true); retainer, blood 1, animal, req ani
verdicts.theirs: Employed retainer gets close-range 1 damage each round (not ranged), environmental, inflicted even against dodge
verdicts.fix: Add an ani mode: envDmgPerRound 1, close range only (not ranged), during normal strike resolution; environmental damage with the retainer as source. Also at ANI: the same 1 damage per round plus the optional press (carry both).
verdicts.why: The ani 1 damage per round is the card's main effect and our entry carries only the superior press; the superior line says 'As above' so the damage belongs at ANI too (a Carrion Crows style envDmgPerRound exists).

verdicts.question: other clauses
verdicts.ours: ANI press:true; animal:true; cost blood 1; no life
verdicts.theirs: Two modes: damage 1 close-range; damage plus HostCombatPress 1
verdicts.fix: At ANI add the 1 damage per round (as at ani) beside the press. Retainer life 2 is not carried (retainer life is table-handled in our entries, as noted for Murder of Crows); the press is an optional 1 press each combat for the employer.
verdicts.why: ANI is read as press only, missing the inherited damage; cost, animal tag and press are right.

verdicts.question: AUS level with no mode
verdicts.ours: no mode at AUS (only aus intercept 1)
verdicts.theirs: Mode: reacting minion with ability to attempt a block of any action ignoring who may block; one attempt
verdicts.fix: Add a superior (AUS) mode: reaction by a vampire to make a block attempt on the current action ignoring the prey/predator/target restriction on who may block; all other block requirements still apply (Blood Bond, Day Operation, Seduction, a prior decision not to block are not bypassed) and it covers one attempt only. The key for a reaction that grants a block attempt regardless of who may block does not exist.
verdicts.why: The superior is a different effect (a block attempt itself, widening who may block) and our entry offers only the +1 intercept, so a bot never uses the superior at all.

verdicts.question: other clauses
verdicts.ours: aus intercept 1, react, req aus
verdicts.theirs: InterceptNeeded then AddIntercept 1
verdicts.why: The inferior +1 intercept is carried; the flagged gap is only the superior.

verdicts.question: who plays it (dom|obl)
verdicts.ours: mod, limited, dom/obl bleed 1; no actor or target conditions
verdicts.theirs: Played by another own ready unlocked vampire; the acting minion must be a wraith or zombie ally; bleed action only; limited
verdicts.fix: Add conditions: the card is played by a ready unlocked vampire you control other than the acting minion, and only when the acting minion is a wraith or zombie ally performing a bleed; the +1 bleed goes to that ally. Our entry as written reads as bleed +1 played by the acting minion (e.g. a vampire bleeding).
verdicts.why: The text restricts both the player (another ready unlocked vampire) and the acting minion (wraith or zombie ally); our entry is a plain +1 bleed modifier that a bot would consider for any bleed of its own.

verdicts.question: who plays it (DOM|OBL)
verdicts.ours: DOM/OBL bleed 1 only
verdicts.theirs: Same, plus unlock the acting ally for 1 blood of the playing vampire after resolution (whatever the result)
verdicts.fix: At DOM/OBL add: after the action resolves (successful, failed or blocked), the playing vampire may burn 1 blood to unlock the acting ally; same who-plays and ally-only conditions as at the inferior.
verdicts.why: The unlock-for-1-blood rider is missing and the same player and ally restrictions apply.

verdicts.question: other clauses
verdicts.ours: limited:true; the four levels split
verdicts.theirs: Two modes with LIMITED_BLEED
verdicts.why: The numbers (+1 bleed), the limited flag and the or-split of disciplines are carried; the gaps are the who-plays and the unlock, in the lines above.

verdicts.question: pre ongoing modifier
verdicts.ours: pre fx bleed 1 on the action mode (reads as this action's bleed); persistent
verdicts.theirs: Attach to the actor, bearer +1 bleed, no vampire with another Heart of the City
verdicts.fix: The +1 bleed is the bearer's bleed stat while the card stays on this vampire (a bearer stat, like the stealth of Blithe Acceptance), not a bleed of this action, which is a +1 stealth non-bleed action. Also carry one per vampire (a vampire can have only one Heart of the City).
